verdict.rationale: Vue's docs explicitly state it 'builds on top of standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript' with an intuitive API, and community reports corroborate that Vue's SFC syntax (HTML templates, CSS, JS) is easy to learn quickly ('learn basics in minutes', 'a few hours from scratch', 'not steep at all'). One counterpoint notes complexity in advanced cases (template DSL limitations, TS typing), but this is a secondary nuance not a contradiction of the core low-learning-curve claim. missing for 10: independent benchmark/study beyond forum anecdotes, and no first-party tutorial excerpt directly quoted alongside the community quotes.
